notes.text: Typed thesis-defense notice, N°: 2418, dated ‘MONTPELLIER, le 19 AVRIL 1977’, for BAYER Michel’s ‘Etude gravimétrique de la Corse.’ The two underlined heading lines announce a doctorate of speciality in ‘SCIENCES DE LA TERRE mention GEOLOGIE APPLIQUEE’. It gives ‘25 AVRIL 1977 à 14 h. 30’, ‘Salle de cours n° 10 - U.S.T.L.’, the director M. LOUIS Pierre, Laboratoire de Géophysique, a proposed five-person jury and ‘Deux ans’. The abstract reports 270 additional measurements and 720 stations, and explicitly says ‘Des hypothèses sont proposées’ for the deep structure of Corsica and nearby regions. These claims are recorded, not independently researched. The typed signatory is E. SIAU; the autograph remains E S|E Siau. The lower-left pencil 3 is archival numbering; no mathematical check arises from this page.
